headline: Home Health Nurse

experience.title: Home Health Nurse
bullets: Visit about 15 elderly and chronically ill patients a week at home.
Assess patients, check vital signs and wounds, and monitor their response to treatment.
Give and supervise medicines and teach families how to give them safely.
Document every visit and send updates to the attending physicians.
Train family caregivers in bathing, turning and fall prevention.

experience.title: Staff Nurse
bullets: Cared for adult patients on the medical ward, many of them older adults.
Responded to emergencies with the code team.

summary: Registered nurse with three years in hospital and home health care in Misamis Occidental. I assess and monitor older patients at home, manage their medicines and records, and work closely with family caregivers. My work sits between nursing and caregiving.

notes: Registered Nurse, Philippine Nurse Licensure Examination, 2022
